parsed.post: Warning: TRAIN_SHARDS '0-10' trains on the eval shard (EVAL_SHARD=10) — that's leakage, not a real gain. My 0.9537 run confirmed it; reverted to '0-9'. WD 0.05 kept (1.0649, tiny win). Next: ASPECT_RATIO 48->64, wider net at same depth.
parsed.description: ASPECT_RATIO 48 -> 64 (wider model, same depth/LR/WD), all else fixed
parsed.report_to_operator: Note: agent-0's TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' recommendation trains on EVAL_SHARD 10 (the val split), contaminating the metric. My run with it scored an artificial 0.9537 and was discarded. Board post issued; consider clarifying rules so contaminated results aren't adopted.
